headline: Jerónimo had a fall on 2026-09-25 and then about two weeks of new evening confusion (reported 2026-11-02, including a stove left on). His caregiver grandson reported exhaustion on 2026-11-22 and asked for respite.

items.statement: On 2026-11-02 his grandson Robert reported about two weeks of increased evening confusion, with the stove left on once. Jerónimo was oriented to person and place but not date, and had no fever. The nurse planned a urinalysis, medication review and PCP visit that week. The notes dated after 2026-11-02 do not show results or outcomes for these.
items.verifier_note: Note n004 matches all details (two weeks evening confusion, stove, orientation, no fever, plan). The later cited note (11-13) shows no results or outcomes, consistent with the statement.

items.statement: On 2026-09-25 he fell at home getting out of bed and was found on the floor by his grandson. He denied head strike and loss of consciousness. He had a small left forearm skin tear, which was dressed. Fall risk was reassessed as high and a PT referral was placed. The encounter record shows no ED visit or hospital stay in the period.
items.verifier_note: Note n002 supports all clinical details. The encounters record is empty, consistent with no ED visit or hospital stay.

items.statement: On 2026-11-22 Robert, his primary caregiver, reported exhaustion and poor sleep. He is worried about managing evenings alone and requested respite. Respite options and a caregiver support group were discussed. The notes do not show an outcome. This follows the reported evening confusion.
items.verifier_note: Note n001 supports the caregiver exhaustion, poor sleep, worry about evenings, respite request, and discussion. No outcome is documented. The link to the 11-02 evening confusion is a fair temporal follow-on.

items.statement: The PT evaluation on 2026-09-29 found his gait slow and unsteady with intermittent cane use, and a Timed Up and Go of 19 seconds. PT recommended a front-wheeled walker, a home safety evaluation and bathroom grab bars, with PT twice weekly. The notes do not show whether the walker, home evaluation or grab bars are in place, or how PT is progressing.
items.verifier_note: Note n003 supports gait, TUG 19 s, walker, home safety evaluation, grab bars, and PT twice weekly. The absence of follow-up in the cited notes is accurately stated.

items.statement: No influenza vaccine is recorded for the current season, which started 2026-08-01. The most recent flu vaccine on record was 2026-06-30, before the season began.
items.verifier_note: The immunization record shows flu_vaccine_this_season false, season start 2026-08-01, and the most recent flu vaccine on 2026-06-30, before the season.

questions_for_team: Were the urinalysis, medication review and PCP visit planned on 2026-11-02 completed, and what were the results?
Is the new evening confusion being evaluated alongside the 2026-09-25 fall, and what safety measures cover the stove and evenings?
What respite or evening coverage can be arranged for Robert, and by when?

Should a flu vaccine for this season be offered?

Note that no medications are currently listed for migraine or pain, so verify this is accurate.

Pain and migraine burden: count migraine days and pain scores in the window, rescue medication use, and any change in function caused by pain or headaches; note whether any new treatment was started or stopped.
Blood pressure and heart rate trend in the window, given new beta-blocker therapy: check for hypotension, bradycardia, dizziness, or missed readings, and whether values were reviewed by a clinician.
Weight and BMI trend (obesity on record) across the window, and any dietary or activity changes, including changes related to the new cardiac diagnosis.

Function and ADLs/IADLs: compare current status with the last review for mobility (scoliosis history), transfers, bathing, dressing, medication management, and driving or transport; note any new equipment needs.

Cognition, mood, and attendance: screen for changes in cognition, depression or anxiety (chronic pain, serious new cardiac diagnosis, substance use history), and check PACE day-center attendance and missed appointments in the window.

Caregiver and care-plan items: confirm caregiver or support status and any changes since enrollment (2024-04-21); list care-plan goals, assessments, and reviews due by 2026-11-30, and flag any open items from the prior IDT meeting. Allergies are listed as none; confirm this with the participant.
